description: Source code for the 'higherlower' package implementing a Higher or Lower game with styling, game logic, and user interaction functions.

classes.name: Game
classes.description: Represents the state and logic of a Higher or Lower game.

methods.name: NewGame
methods.description: Creates a new game instance with a random starting number within specified range.

methods.name: ValidateGuess
methods.description: Checks if a player's guess is valid ('higher' or 'lower').

methods.name: GetPlayerGuess
methods.description: Prompts the player for their guess using a prompter interface.

methods.name: GenerateNextNumber
methods.description: Generates the next random number for the game.

methods.name: Play
methods.description: Executes a game round based on the player's guess and updates game state.

methods.name: GetResult
methods.description: Returns a string describing the outcome of the last guess.

methods.name: UpdateForNextRound
methods.description: Prepares the game for the next round by updating the current number.

methods.name: PlayGame
methods.description: Main function to run the game loop, handling user interaction and game flow.
